marketLayer.title: US Mega-Cap Tech & AI Infrastructure Capex
marketLayer.fact: Leading US technology giants reported continued double-digit growth in capital expenditure for AI server infrastructure and custom silicon, while revenue guidance from cloud software partners showed initial signs of acceleration.
marketLayer.inference: Upstream semiconductor, optical module, and server assembly supply chains will likely retain strong valuation support, reinforcing rotation back into mega-cap tech stocks.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of corporate AI monetization and potential supply constraints in high-bandwidth memory (HBM).

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Internet & E-Commerce Valuation Recovery
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index rebounded as major Chinese e-commerce and social platforms announced expanded share repurchases and cross-border expansion targets following solid Q2 top-line trends.
marketLayer.inference: Increased shareholder return programs via buybacks and dividends are setting a higher valuation floor for HK-listed internet majors despite cautious domestic consumption.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Intensity of ongoing domestic price competition and margin pressures in core e-commerce segments.

marketLayer.title: US Federal Reserve Monetary Policy & Treasury Yields
marketLayer.fact: US core inflation metrics landed in line with consensus expectations, reinforcing market pricing for a potential 25 basis point Fed rate cut in upcoming policy meetings, driving a slight decline in 10-year Treasury yields.
marketLayer.inference: Easing long-end yields reduce discount rate pressures on growth equities and improve liquidity conditions for emerging market capital inflows.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Resilience of labor market data and future inflation revisions driven by logistics or energy cost fluctuations.

marketLayer.title: HK-Listed Chinese EV & Automotive Supply Chain
marketLayer.fact: Prominent Chinese EV manufacturers reported surging export delivery figures across Southeast Asia and Latin America alongside local trade-in subsidy programs.
marketLayer.inference: Overseas expansion and domestic trade-in incentives will help offset local price competition, favoring EV leaders with strong global logistics networks.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolution of international tariff policies and trade barriers in major export markets.
